info.title: Sayless Public API
info.description: Curated work-graph HTTP API for integrations. Authenticate with Bearer personal API keys (`sl_api_…`) or OAuth tokens (`sl_oat_…`), including app-actor / client_credentials. See Developers → Authentication for scopes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Safe retries for create/send: same key + route + workspace returns the cached success body for 24h. API/OAuth only.
